digest.component_or_area: test suite quality — Jira DC transport and pagination guard
propositions: Five tests have assertions that cannot fail: the PAT-repr test constructs a transport that never receives a credential; the pagination guard teeth test re-implements the predicate inline instead of calling it; validate_assignee_exists is only asserted to exist, not to return a string; the rate-limit sweep asserts total <= 1 instead of == 1, allowing zero calls; the unknown-backend test asserts only a class relationship, not calling select_backend.
The PAT-repr test must build a transport around a credential-carrying client and assert the credential's value is absent from repr(), or the test is decoration.

The pagination guard helper _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() must accept an optional source parameter so the teeth test can feed it a synthetic unpaginated call and assert it reports the offender, not merely runs.

The validate_assignee_exists test must call the method against a client with a matching user record and assert the return value is a username string, not a bool or accountId, for both DC and Cloud backends.

The rate-limit sweep must assert total == 1 per member and replace the blanket pytest.raises(Exception) with pytest.raises(BackendHTTPError) with .code == 429 asserted per member, so pre-flight failures are caught.

The unknown-backend test must exercise select_backend on both a known key (positive control) and an unknown key, asserting BackendRegistryError is raised and its message names both the missing key and registered ones.
